messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from today's AH Q&A  wanted to capture the key clarifications so folks don't have to dig through the recording. Main topics: Dedicated GA timing, signup window, SLA publication, and migration/runbook owners.

marta: To be explicit: GA target = Sept 18. We'll open commit signups on July 22 (mid-summer). Marketing will need the teaser copy by July 1 to hit the channel schedule.

owen: I'll own the migration/runbook. Plan: draft checklist + example terraform + a short playbook for SE handoffs. Will post WIP PR in infra/docs by next Tue.

violet: I'll draft the GA announcement + a short FAQ for customers. If product can share the SLA numbers and signup link by July 22 I'll schedule the blog and email.

jess: Legal note: committed contracts require a short addendum for data residency options. Please loop legal@redwood.com before public contracts go out.

ana: SLA update: we'll publish target uptime + two latency buckets (p95 read-only workloads and p99 interactive). Exact percentages are in review; we'll publish placeholder SLOs with the GA landing and update with final numbers within 2 weeks.

owen: quick snippet I'm prototyping for the migration playbook (will add more context in the PR):
```
# terraform example (snippet)
module "redwood_dedicated" {
  source = "git::https://git.redwood/modules/dedicated.git"
  capacity_commit = 8
  region = "us-west-2"
}
```

deploy-bot: Notice: doc "dedicated-ga-plan" updated by ana 8h ago9 changelog: "GA date + signup window added"

marta: Action items roundup: 
- ana: finalize signup link + landing page by July 22 (owner: ana)
- owen: migration/runbook PR in infra/docs by Tue (owner: owen)
- violet: GA announcement draft + FAQ by July 8 (owner: violet)
- jess: prepare contract addendum template and sync with finance (owner: jess)
I'll convert to tickets and add owners in Jira. If anyone needs to be CC'd on the announcement thread ping me. Thanks everyone :rocket:
